counterexample: LEFT25 preservation anchor actual success became deterministic timeout; mean sampled-history KL<.005 did not preserve closed-loop success.
hypothesis: Subtracting a group mean across all physical decision times in a batch of similarly successful episodes can change which successful actions are encouraged. It is a legal baseline/normalization choice, not a proved bug or unique cause.
test: Reuse exactly four actual T490 trajectories, same initial39 Actor/Value/mature Adam, same anchors/16epoch/PPO/KL; change only advantage to signed raw finite-return G-V divided by side-balanced RMS, with no mean subtraction.
